text_summary.body: Sanballat, furious, mocked the feeble Jews before his associates and the army of Samaria; Tobiah said a fox would break their wall. Nehemiah prayed that their insult return on them. When the wall reached half its height, Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, Ammonites and Ashdodites plotted to attack; the Jews prayed and set a watch; Nehemiah stationed families with weapons; thereafter half worked and half held weapons, builders wore swords, a trumpeter stood by Nehemiah, and all lodged in Jerusalem.

setting.period: During the 52 days of building (445 BC)
setting.body: Sanballat's authority in Samaria is attested a generation later (Elephantine papyrus 30). The Ammonites and Ashdodites flank Judah east and west; the Arabs are probably Geshem's people.
